node.title: Re^3: How to convert bigint to bytearray in perl
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Can't locate object method "to_bytes" via package "Math::BigInt"

The to_bytes method was added in [mod://Math::BigInt] 1.999807, which was distributed with Perl 5.28. You should be able to install the latest version from CPAN.
